headlines.description: Alice Huang, the woman at the center of the Nvidia scandal kept in contact with China’s top spy agency from the spring of 2025 until fall 2026, according to the New York Times. That time period overlaps with her relationship with Jensen Huang who was ousted as the chip company’s CEO.

headlines.name: The U.S. Army moves forward with Iowa detonation despite major health concerns
headlines.headline: The U.S. Army moves forward with Iowa detonation despite major health concerns
headlines.description: The U.S. Army is moving forward with a controversial plan to detonate 10,000 pounds of explosives at an Iowa ammunition plant after invoking emergency powers to bypass a court order that had temporarily halted the operation. NBC News’ Misty Marris breaks down the legal battle and the potential health and environmental concerns surrounding the detonation.

sources.name: Phys.org
sources.title: Robot submarine exploring world's deepest ocean trench finds unprecedented volcanic activity
sources.description: Fifty-two million years ago, the Pacific tectonic plate began to slide under the Philippine Sea plate, forming the Mariana Trench, the deepest known valley on the Earth's ocean floor. The deepest part of this abyss, the Challenger Deep, is almost 11,000 meters (36,000 feet) below sea level. But why is it so deep?
